items.title: Meal breaks
items.note: Flag any straight shift scheduled over six hours. A warning on the schedule, not a policy change.

items.title: Minor hours
items.note: TN: no 16/17-year-old works 10 PM to 6 AM on a school night. Warn when a minor is scheduled past ~9 on a school night, and when a minor is still clocked in approaching 10. School calendar drives it. Needs DOBs from Toast (name + DOB only, no SSNs); Jason exports.

items.title: Overtime
items.note: Heads-up at 32 hours, hard alert at 38. Goes to the GM only.

items.title: Food manager cards
items.note: Rudd, Walt, Tim, Jeff, Drew, Ryan certified Sep 28 2026; Jason May 28. All expire 5 years out. Warn at 90 days.

items.title: Every night
items.note: Pizza, fry, grill, sandwich, float, expo, dish. Never below that.

items.title: Flat top
items.note: The only collapsible position. Folds into grill; stands alone Fri, Sat, Sun.

items.title: Dish
items.note: 1 day / 2 night Mon-Sat, 2 and 2 Sunday. Never collapsible.

items.title: Float and pizza catch
items.note: Float is the manager, usually Ryan: salaried, so it doesn't count against the 20% hourly target, but it must show as covered. Pizza catch added on heavy nights. "Pizza oven" dropped.

items.title: Stations
items.note: Fryer; Grill/Flat Top (one station); Pizza Make; Pizza Catch; Salad/Mac; Expo; Dish. High volume adds a line float between grill and fryer and a second pizza make. Count pizza catch once.

items.title: Expo
items.note: Drew or Jeff, rotating. Neither is fixed at expo. Whoever stands there counts as covered; salaried time stays out of the 20% hourly target.

items.title: Dish
items.note: PM only, one dedicated person ~4 to 9:30. Sunday gets AM and PM. Daytime dish duties shared.

items.title: FOH tiers
items.note: Quiet lunch: servers + FOH manager, no host/phone/runner. Slower dinner: combined host/phone-to-go, runner, 3-4 servers. Busy: host and phone split, ~4 servers, runner, no separate busser.

items.title: Line checks
items.note: Morning by 11, alert 11:30. Afternoon by 3:30, alert 4. Owned by Drew or Jeff, then GM; GM is vacant, so Jason or Rudd. Overdue goes to both owners. No Tuesday service checks. Commissary production still runs Tuesday.

items.title: Timing
items.note: Rudd's prep and turn times are shorter than Bert's. Do not copy Bert's timing assumptions.

items.title: Single-deep alerts
items.note: Free once both station floors are loaded into Companion's coverage engine.

items.title: Operations calendar
items.note: One shared Google Calendar for now: hood cleaning, Taste of Monroe (Oct, all-hands), homecoming, games, holidays, school days off, in-service. Both owners add; managers see it while writing the schedule. JMAX pulls it in later.

items.title: Shift swaps and pickups
items.note: Built in Companion's scheduling engine.

items.title: Station clearance and trainers
items.note: Built in Companion.

items.title: Targets
items.note: Hourly labor 20% (hourly wages only, salaried managers excluded), food 37%, prime 57%. Wired into the scorecards.

items.title: Toast hourly sales
items.note: While the schedule is written, plain warnings: "last four Fridays averaged $1,800 from 6-7 PM, you have three cooks on." A warning, not a report.

items.title: Voids and comps
items.note: Nobody checks them today. Weekly list per store by person, flagged above store average. GM sees it first. Same name two weeks running goes to Jason and Rudd.

items.title: Tips
items.note: Pooled and paid inside Toast at all three stores. JMAX only reads the result.

items.title: Cash and deposits
items.note: Toast expected, counted at close, deposit slip; breaks surface next morning. Fixed deposit days: two a week at Bert's and Rudd's, one at Papa's. The reminder follows the deposit day even when the store is closed; Tuesday closure does NOT silence it.

items.title: Which deposit days
items.note: Each GM picks. Rudd's first; Bert's and Papa's after.

items.title: Staff profiles
items.note: Station ratings, trainer status, carrot, allergies. Birth date and leader/follower dropped. Carrot is GM-only.

items.title: AI-drafted schedules
items.note: Start from what the volume calls for, staffed with who's strong for those hours. Not a copy of last week. Prove it at Bert's and Rudd's first.

items.title: End-of-shift check-in
items.note: Three rough faces out of five raises a flag to the GM. GM sees the count first and can open it.

items.title: Onboarding vs training
items.note: Onboarding = paperwork + into Toast. Training is separate: paired with a trainer until the GM signs off, which turns on station clearance. Trainees add coverage, not a required slot. Rudd's trainers: +$1/hr for the training shift, premium parking, free meal except steak.

items.title: Rudd's new-hire handoff
items.note: Lacey writes FOH, Drew writes BOH, so they own getting a hire on the schedule. The step from hired to scheduled is still undefined.

items.title: System accounts
items.note: "Server One" is the to-go/DoorDash account at Bert's and Rudd's. Flag on the person: system account yes/no. Flagged accounts drop out of labor, scheduling and profiles; sales still count. Papa's online default: name to confirm with Will.

items.title: Clock-in without a shift
items.note: Friendly one-tap flag: "Bella worked Tuesday with no scheduled shift. Add it?"

items.title: Training hours
items.note: Two new Toast job codes, trainee and trainer. Year one measures, year two budgets. Stays inside the 20%; scorecard shows labor with and without it.

items.title: Schedule source
items.note: Rudd's = Sling, Bert's = HotSchedules, Papa's = Excel (JMAX reads a photo for now). Both apps stay for now; JMAX owns the schedule data and grows into Companion's engine to replace them.

items.title: Safety and compliance
items.note: Temp logs, inspections, permit renewals, incidents. Temps outside limit trigger a corrective action and write the health inspection log.

items.title: Guests and listings
items.note: Reviews, complaints, Google and Facebook listings.

items.title: Bert's prep sheet
items.note: 34 real items with owner-set pars. Shredded lettuce and Philly pucks still need pars from Tim.

items.title: Manager log
items.note: Screen built from the Red Book. Saving version live in the Rudd's pilot.

items.title: Prime cost scorecard
items.note: Bert's and Papa's real numbers loaded (different periods). Rudd's not pulled yet.

items.title: Build card photos
items.note: Missing pepperoni count/weight per size; illustration doesn't match the finished photo.

items.title: Catering menu and BEO
items.note: Papa's BEO works; rebuild so every calendar event prints its own.

items.title: Database spine
items.note: Supabase (jaymaxcorp), 16 tables, RLS on, service role only. Script 01 run live.

items.title: Access policies (Script 02)
items.note: Codex and Claude read-only; Jeff's app writes only counts, invoices, items. Staff logins after hosting.

items.title: Scheduled export to Drive
items.note: The step everyone skips. Must be set up.

items.title: Jeff's real data
items.note: His live data is in his own MongoDB. Needs a read-only export before anything loads.

items.title: Sling/Toast connection, payroll export
items.note: Read roster and time clock instead of retyping; match whatever payroll uses.
